description: Latest audited annual financials of a European listed company from its ESEF (IFRS iXBRL) annual report: revenue, operating profit, net income, total assets, equity, cash, borrowings and derived net debt, with currency, fiscal year, prior year and the filing URL; each figure traced to its IFRS tag. Give an LEI, or a company name and ISO-2 country. 0.005 USDC per call, charged only if financials are found.

country.description: ISO-2 country of the issuer, required with company (FR, IT, NL, BE, FI, DK, AT, SE, ES...)
